_comment: UNC Re-Engage Cockpit — reviving a lead who went quiet on the email sequence. Caller is whoever's on the phone (rep_name). Method: pattern-interrupt second touch, permission-based, LOW pressure. Goal: Phone → Permission → Email. Never hard-close on this call.

opener._note: They got the email sequence, never replied. This call is the human second touch. No pitch. Curiosity + honesty.
opener.default: Hey {first_name} — it's {rep_name} with Urban Niche Co. I'll keep this quick, I promise. We sent a couple things your way over the last few weeks and I didn't want it to just get buried in your inbox. No pitch here — real quick: are you getting all the {trade_lower} work you want right now, or is more of the right kind of calls something you'd take?

NO_LEADS.label: No / could be better
NO_LEADS.script: That's exactly why I picked up the phone instead of sending another email. When we looked at {business_name}, the one thing that stood out was {ai_hook} — and that's usually what's quietly costing you calls you never even hear about. I'm not going to pitch you on this call. Can I just send you one thing that shows what we've done for other {trade_lower} contractors in {city}? You look at it, and if it's not for you, no hard feelings.

GET_THE_YES.label: They said yes — confirm email
GET_THE_YES.script: Perfect. I'll get that over to you today. Is {email} still the best place to reach you?
GET_THE_YES.confirm_prompt: Confirm the email → 'Great — it comes from ricky@urbannicheco.com, so keep an eye out for that name. Appreciate you, {first_name}. Talk soon.'

LEADS_ARE_FINE.label: Leads are fine / we're good
LEADS_ARE_FINE.script: Love hearing that — genuinely, that's the position every contractor wants to be in. I won't take up more of your day. If word-of-mouth ever slows down or you want to stop depending on it, you know where we are. Appreciate your time, {first_name}.

DONT_REMEMBER.label: Don't remember the emails
DONT_REMEMBER.script: No worries at all — inbox is a warzone, happens to everyone. Quick version: we only work with {trade_lower} contractors, nobody else. When we looked at {business_name}, the thing that jumped out was {ai_hook} — that's fixable, and it's probably costing you calls right now. Want me to resend it with a little more context so you can actually see what I'm talking about?

WHAT_IS_THIS.label: Who is this / what do you do
WHAT_IS_THIS.script: Fair question — we do digital marketing, and only for {trade_lower} contractors. We reached out a couple weeks back because when we pulled up {business_name}, {ai_hook} stood out. That's the whole reason for the call — nothing more. Can I send you something quick on it so it's not just me talking?

WANTS_TO_MOVE_FORWARD.label: They want to talk pricing / move forward
WANTS_TO_MOVE_FORWARD.script: Love it. That's a conversation worth doing right, so let me get you time with Ricky — he's the one who scopes the actual plan and the numbers. Fifteen minutes, I'll set it up. What's better for you, mornings or afternoons?
WANTS_TO_MOVE_FORWARD.note: Log HOT. Create a HubSpot task to book the discovery call. Do NOT quote pricing yourself — hand it to Ricky.

BAD_TIME.label: Bad time / busy
BAD_TIME.script: Totally get it — you're working, that's a good sign. When's a better window to catch you, tomorrow morning work?
BAD_TIME.note: Get a SPECIFIC time. Log WARM with the callback window.

voicemail.script: Hey {first_name} — it's {rep_name} with Urban Niche Co. We flagged something on {business_name} a few weeks back and I wanted to make sure it actually reached you instead of just sitting in an inbox. Give me a shout when you get a sec — {rep_phone}. Talk soon.

cockpit_note: GOAL: Phone → Permission → Email. Do NOT close on this call. Get the yes to send one thing, confirm the email, hang up — the email system takes it from there. If they want to move forward → log HOT and get Ricky on a call.

outcomes.HOT: Wants to move forward — book Ricky discovery call
outcomes.WARM: Interested, needs callback or email confirmed
outcomes.EMAILED: Got permission, email confirmed — sequence resumes
